QF.id: AIFM Fund Monitoring, Reporting, and Exit_16

question.text: Mr. Vikram Desai is Compliance Officer at Aravalli Venture Fund. Per Regulation 20 / Second Amendment 2021, any deviation from SEBI (AIF) Regulations must be independently reported by him to SEBI within:

answer.text: Only at the next quarterly filing

explanation.text: The Logic: Under Regulation 20 (as amended by the Second Amendment 2021), the Compliance Officer must independently report any deviation from the SEBI (AIF) Regulations to SEBI forthwith, within 7 working days. This is an obligation on the Compliance Officer that operates independently of the manager or trustee. The Trap: '24 hours' is not the AIF reporting window. 'Only at the next quarterly filing' defeats the forthwith-reporting purpose of the regulation. Note: The Compliance Test Report (CTR) workflow has its own separate timeline and is not the same as the per-deviation reporting obligation in Regulation 20.
